title: Where to Start, How to Move: Analyzing Curricula under GRPO for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.19349v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) provides no reward-relative learning signal when all rollouts receive identical rewards. In long-horizon tasks that require multiple interactions, rewards are given only upon successful task completion, making all-fail groups common early in training and limiting opportunities to practice later steps. Guide Assisted GRPO replays a successful reference prefix before the learner continues. We study how initial positions, handoff units, and movement rules affect unassisted task completion. Across three model sizes on BFCL, starting near completion is more effective under a fixed turn-level threshold rule. Finer handoffs alone do not consistently help, but outcome-informed tool-call selection outperforms GRPO on trained and untrained task categories. Guided starts also improve AppWorld success on both evaluation splits. These findings highlight where learning starts and how starting positions move

translated_title: 从哪里开始，如何移动：分析长程LLM智能体在GRPO下的课程
translated_abstract: 当所有采样（rollouts）获得相同的奖励时，组相对策略优化（GRPO）无法提供基于奖励差异的学习信号。在需要多次交互的长程任务中，奖励只在成功完成任务后才给出，这使得训练早期“全部失败”的组非常常见，限制了模型练习后续步骤的机会。引导辅助GRPO（Guide Assisted GRPO）在学习者继续之前重放一段成功的参考前缀。我们研究了初始位置、交接单元和移动规则如何影响无辅助情况下的任务完成率。在BFCL上跨三种模型规模的实验表明，在固定的回合级阈值规则下，从接近完成的阶段开始更为有效。更细粒度的交接本身并不能持续带来帮助，但基于结果信息的工具调用选择在已训练和未训练的任务类别上都优于GRPO。引导式开始也提升了AppWorld在两个评估集上的成功率。这些发现强调了学习从哪里开始以及起始位置如何移动的重要性。
tldr: 该研究系统分析了引导辅助GRPO课程设计，发现在固定回合级阈值规则下“从接近完成的阶段开始”最有效，且基于结果信息的工具调用选择在已训练和未训练任务类别上均优于标准GRPO。
en_tdlr: This study systematically analyzes Guide Assisted GRPO curricula for long-horizon LLM agents, finding that starting near task completion under a fixed turn-level threshold rule is most effective, and outcome-informed tool-call selection outperforms standard GRPO on both trained and untrained task categories.
